source: TUNING GUESS: visit radius 30 m, about 17 boat lengths (the Laser is 4.2 m), so a pass at a sensible distance counts; no rounding direction is required. Sandbox challenge, not a race mark rounding rule.

buoyTour.title: Buoy tour
buoyTour.description: Sail within 30 m of every buoy in the bay, in any order.
